answer_1.quote: We demonstrate ADACAD's effectiveness on a diverse range of tasks, covering question-answering (QA) and summarization, with six QA datasets (Natural Question (NQ; , NQ-SWAP , TriviaQA , PopQA , HotpotQA , TabMWP ) and three summarization datasets (CNN-DM , XSum , and TofuEval ).

answer_2.quote: We report exact match accuracy on all QA datasets. [...] We use two reference-based metrics, ROUGE-L and BERT-P, to evaluate summarization quality. As TofuEval does not support reference-based evaluation, we use recommended AlignScore to measure the factual consistency of summaries on both main (central to the document) and marginal (lesser explored) topics.
